title: AI-ssignment
description: Settings for the AI-only student preview.

students.title: Student models
students.description: Models acting as AI-only students, as '<provider>:<model>'. Empty = provider defaults.

grader.title: Grader model
grader.description: Model that scores answers and writes suggestions. Empty = provider default.

mode.title: Student type
mode.description: copy = pastes each question separately; whole = pastes the whole notebook; agent = gets the notebook and a kernel to run code in.

allowCodeExecution.title: Run AI-written code
allowCodeExecution.description: Code answers run in a separate kernel on this computer. Asked once before the first run.
